page: Amazon Web Services g7e.12xlarge is a graphics-intensive server instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores with hyperthreading, powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor running at 2.4 GHz. The system includes 512.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing 10.67 GB of RAM per core. For accelerated workloads, the instance is equipped with two NVIDIA Ada Lovelace RTX Pro 6000 GPUs, delivering a combined 192 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 3800 GB NVMe SSD, and the network interface supports a baseline bandwidth of 400 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in single-core Geekbench scores, image processing, and LLM inference speeds across small, medium, and large models for both prompt processing and text generation. Multi-core CPU performance, ray tracing, and memory bandwidth tests consistently rank in the strong tier. The processor supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions, which contribute to its strong performance in cryptographic, compression, and mathematical operations.

From a resource density perspective, the g7e.12xlarge offers a high-density hardware profile, combining substantial GPU memory with 512 GB of DDR5 RAM and fast local storage. This configuration is optimized for workloads requiring concurrent access to large datasets and GPU acceleration. However, the CPU performance in stress-ng tests falls into the average category, indicating that raw non-vectorized CPU compute is not the primary strength of this instance compared to its memory and GPU capabilities.

This instance is designed for memory-intensive graphics workloads, large language model inference, real-time ray tracing, and image processing. The combination of 192 GB VRAM, high-speed DDR5 memory, and 3800 GB of NVMe SSD storage also makes it suitable for database operations, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
